headline: Golf course fees for the 2027 season and the Essex Woods Management Plan, including a trail management section.
summary: Staff will review the 2026 harbor boating and seasonal concession seasons. They will also ask for feedback on both areas.

plain_text:
Parks, Recreation and Harbor 
 
Advisory Committee 
 
November 12, 2026 at 5:15 p.m. 
 
*PAUL BUNYAN ROOM* 
 
City Hall 
 
73 Harlow Street 
 
 
AGENDA 
 
Approval of October meeting minutes 
 
Golf Course Fee Discussion 
  
Staff will be discussing various proposed fees at the Golf Course for 
implementation for the 2027 season.  
  
Essex Woods Management Plan 
  
The Essex Woods Management Plan is completed to include a trail management 
section.  Staff will be reviewing this plan with the Committee. 
 
Waterfront/Harbor/Seasonal Concession 
 
With the 2026 season completed with both the harbor boating season staff will be 
reviewing how each season went and seeking any possible feedback from the 
Committee regarding each of these areas. 
 
Other Business 
 
Adjourn
